children: On September 1, 2026, the company received a Nasdaq notice that it no longer meets the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement under Rule 5450(a)(1) after 30 consecutive business days below $1.00. Trading continues on the Nasdaq Global Market under VHUB, and the company has until March 1, 2027, to regain compliance by maintaining a $1.00 bid for at least 10 consecutive business days, with a potential additional 180-day period if it transfers to the Nasdaq Capital Market and pursues a reverse split if needed.
